items.html: And behold, the reason for what we said — that Aba and Ima have no power to sort all the degrees below them completely, and could sort only the aspect of the ZON in their own world alone — the reason is that the value of all the sparks that need to be sorted is not equal. Therefore, the sparks that are from the aspect of the ZON, which are close in their value to Aba and Ima, can be sorted and rise up to Aba and Ima, to be corrected there. But all the rest of the degrees from there and below have no power to rise to the place of Aba and Ima, for their degree is very low. For had they the power to rise up to Aba and Ima, they would all be called only the aspect of ZON, and there would be no varying degrees.
